Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

 For the Petitioner : Mr. Rakesh Kumar, Advocate
For the State : Mr. R. R. R. Das, A.P.P.

For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. D. K. Jaiswal, Advocate
 ----
08/17.07.2023
 Heard the parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with B. S. City (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 16/2022,
for the offences under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 / 4 of the Dowary Prohibition Act, pending in the court of Miss Rashim Chandel, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bokaro.

entities.text: B. S. City (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 16/2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Petitioner is the husband of the opposite party No.2.
It was submitted that parties have settled their dispute.
Mr. D. K. Jaiswal, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party No.2 also submitted that parties have settled their dispute.
The offence relates to matrimonial dispute between the parties.
Parties have already settled their dispute.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Miss Rashim Chandel, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class,
Bokaro or her successor in connection with B. S. City (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 16/2022.
